A CLEAR ROLE. A USEFUL NEXT STEP.

What is an AI employee?

An AI employee is a business-focused AI assistant with a defined role, approved information and agreed actions. It can handle routine phone enquiries, collect details and help with bookings, while passing requests that need human judgement to your team.

QuikTalk AI is based in Auckland and works with businesses in New Zealand and Australia. We shape the assistant around your calls, business information and connected tools.

Explore the systems behind your AI employee

A useful first answer

Share the services, opening hours and answers you approve. Collect the details needed for the next step instead of sending your team an incomplete message.

Clear booking requests

Gather the customer’s preferred time, location and reason for calling. Confirm a booking only when connected availability and your rules permit it.

A clear next step

With your tools connected, save agreed details, create a follow-up task or send an approved message. Your team can see what still needs attention.

Your team keeps the decisions that need a person.

Complaints, unusual requests, sensitive questions and anything outside the approved role follow your handoff rules. You decide what the assistant may book, send or update, and what needs staff approval.

START WITH ONE JOB

How we shape your AI employee.

A clear scope makes the assistant easier to review and gives your team a useful first step.

  1. 01

    Choose one role

    Start with the calls that create the most repeated work: reception, bookings or new enquiries. Agree on what a useful outcome looks like.

  2. 02

    Set the information and rules

    Provide accurate service details, opening hours, common answers, booking conditions and a named handoff contact. Decide what needs approval.

  3. 03

    Check the connections

    Review phone routing and any calendar, booking or customer-system access. Confirm compatibility, permissions and provider costs before connecting tools.

  4. 04

    Review calls before launch

    Try routine enquiries, unclear requests and cases that need a person. Review the answers and follow-up actions with your team, then agree on ongoing updates.

Where does an AI employee fit?

Different types of call handling solve different problems. Choose around the work your callers need done.

Comparing call-handling options
OptionWhat it is designed to doWhat to consider
VoicemailRecord a message for your team to return.A person still needs to listen, collect any missing details and follow up.

AI employeeHave a conversation within an approved role and help with agreed tasks.Accurate business information, supported connections and clear handoff rules are essential.

PRACTICAL ANSWERS

Common questions about AI employees.

What can an AI employee do for my business?

An AI employee can answer approved questions, collect enquiry details, take messages and help with bookings. With the right tools connected, it may also update a customer record, send an agreed confirmation or create a follow-up task. We confirm which actions fit your systems before enabling them.

Is an AI employee the same as an AI voice agent?

An AI voice agent is the software that speaks with callers. An AI employee is the business role we give that agent, such as receptionist, booking assistant or enquiry assistant. That role defines the information it can use, the work it can do and when it should involve your team.

Can it keep our existing phone number and booking software?

We review your current phone provider, call routing, booking tools and customer systems first. Some setups support forwarding or a direct integration; others need a different arrangement. Compatibility, access and any provider costs are confirmed before you commit to the setup.

Will it confirm every appointment automatically?

Only when the connected booking system and your agreed rules allow it. If availability cannot be checked, or staff approval is required, it records a request for your team to confirm. The caller should know whether they have a confirmed booking or a pending request.

What happens when the AI cannot answer a question?

We define the handoff process with you. The assistant can take a message, request a callback or transfer a call where supported by the phone setup. Complex, sensitive and out-of-scope requests go to a person; it should not invent an answer or promise an unavailable transfer.

Can it answer calls outside our opening hours?

After-hours handling can be included in the call-routing plan. You choose what the assistant may answer, which requests it can collect and what the caller is told about response times. Availability depends on the agreed phone setup and connected services.

How much does an AI employee cost?

We scope the role before quoting. Relevant factors include call volume and duration, the systems to connect, setup and testing, and the support you need. Ask for a quote that separates setup, ongoing service and any phone or software provider charges. No fixed price is published on this page.

What do we need to provide to get started?

Bring your opening hours, services, common questions, booking rules, phone setup and the details of any tools you want to connect. Choose a team contact for exceptions. We use this information to define one role and review example calls and follow-up actions with you before launch.
